name: Monarch & Mark
about: Independent design studio making websites and landing pages, logos and brand identity kits, and pitch decks for startups and small businesses in the US, UK, Europe and worldwide. Orders are placed through Fiverr or by email. Work is designed from scratch (never templates). Clients receive source files and full commercial rights on completion.

services.name: Websites & landing pages
includes: Custom design, never a stock template
Contact form, socials and basic SEO
Launched on Vercel, Netlify or the client's host
Clean code the client fully owns
services.typical_time: about 3 to 7 days, depending on the number of pages

services.name: Logo & brand identity kit
includes: Original logo concepts to choose from
SVG, PNG and PDF files for web and print

services.name: Pitch decks & presentations
includes: Story structure shaped with the client
Custom slides in the client's brand
services.typical_time: about 3 to 6 days, depending on slide count

process: Discover: short brief, then a fixed quote and delivery date
Design: first version designed from scratch and shared for review
Deliver: finished files in the formats needed (live site, logo files, editable deck)
Revise: included revision rounds until it feels right

faq.a: Through our Fiverr profile, or send a brief by email or with the assistant on this site. Fiverr handles payment securely.
Every package includes revision rounds (2 as standard; more can be added). The exact number is confirmed in your quote.
On completion you receive the source files and full commercial rights.
We can design within your existing logo, colours and fonts, or refresh them.
We can launch websites on Vercel, Netlify or your existing host and connect your domain.
The projects shown on the site are concept work for fictional brands. Client projects will be added as they are delivered.

quote.note: Estimates only. The final fixed price is confirmed before any work starts.
